title: Penguin Slope
tagline: Sled an endless snowy mountain — flip, dodge, collect.
description: Penguin Slope is a 3D endless sled-runner where a cartoon penguin races down a never-ending snowy slope. Swipe left and right to steer between trees, parked cars, ice pillars and city walls; tap to jump and tap mid-air to backflip for a juicy combo bonus. Cruise through four hand-tuned biomes — snowy forest, bright primary-color city, glowing ice cavern and pine-mountain peaks — each with its own obstacles, decor and sky color. Collect coin chains for score multipliers, hit ramps to launch into trick territory, and chase your personal best distance with one quick tap-and-go session.

controls.en: Swipe to steer • Tap to jump • Tap mid-air for backflip
controls.ja: スワイプで操舵・タップでジャンプ・空中タップでバックフリップ
